verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר בִּלְעָם֙ אֶל־ בָּלָ֔ק בְּנֵה־ לִ֥י בָזֶ֖ה שִׁבְעָ֣ה מִזְבְּחֹ֑ת וְהָכֵ֥ן לִי֙ בָּזֶ֔ה שִׁבְעָ֥ה פָרִ֖ים וְשִׁבְעָ֥ה אֵילִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer bil·‘ām ’el- bā·lāq bə·nêh- lî ḇā·zeh šiḇ·‘āh miz·bə·ḥōṯ wə·hā·ḵên lî bā·zeh šiḇ·‘āh p̄ā·rîm wə·šiḇ·‘āh ’ê·lîm
verses.literal: Then Balaam said to Balak Build for me seven altars here and prepare for me . . . seven bulls and seven rams

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ בָּלָ֔ק כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֣ר בִּלְעָ֑ם וַיַּ֨עַל בָּלָ֧ק וּבִלְעָ֛ם פָּ֥ר וָאַ֖יִל בַּמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś bā·lāq ka·’ă·šer dib·ber bil·‘ām way·ya·‘al bā·lāq ū·ḇil·‘ām pār wā·’a·yil bam·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: So Balak did as Balaam had instructed and Balak and Balaam offered a bull and a ram on each altar

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר בִּלְעָ֜ם לְבָלָ֗ק הִתְיַצֵּב֮ עַל־ עֹלָתֶךָ֒ וְאֵֽלְכָ֗ה אוּלַ֞י יִקָּרֵ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לִקְרָאתִ֔י וּדְבַ֥ר מַה־ יַּרְאֵ֖נִי וְהִגַּ֣דְתִּי לָ֑ךְ וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ שֶֽׁפִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer bil·‘ām lə·ḇā·lāq hiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ ‘al- ‘ō·lā·ṯe·ḵā wə·’ê·lə·ḵāh ’ū·lay yiq·qā·rêh Yah·weh liq·rā·ṯî ū·ḏə·ḇar mah- yar·’ê·nî wə·hig·gaḏ·tî lāḵ way·yê·leḵ še·p̄î
verses.literal: Stay here by your burnt offering while I am gone Balaam said to Balak Perhaps . . . the LORD will meet with me . . . And whatever He reveals to me I will tell you So Balaam went off to a barren height

verses.original: וַיִּקָּ֥ר אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶל־ בִּלְעָ֑ם וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו אֶת־ שִׁבְעַ֤ת הַֽמִּזְבְּחֹת֙ עָרַ֔כְתִּי וָאַ֛עַל פָּ֥ר וָאַ֖יִל בַּמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qār ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- bil·‘ām way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw ’eṯ- šiḇ·‘aṯ ham·miz·bə·ḥōṯ ‘ā·raḵ·tî wā·’a·‘al pār wā·’a·yil bam·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: and God met with him I have set up seven altars Balaam said - and on each altar I have offered a bull and a ram

verses.original: וַיָּ֧שֶׂם יְהוָ֛ה דָּבָ֖ר בְּפִ֣י בִלְעָ֑ם וַיֹּ֛אמֶר שׁ֥וּב אֶל־ בָּלָ֖ק וְכֹ֥ה תְדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śem Yah·weh dā·ḇār bə·p̄î ḇil·‘ām way·yō·mer šūḇ ’el- bā·lāq wə·ḵōh ṯə·ḏab·bêr
verses.literal: Then the LORD put a message in Balaam’s mouth saying Return to Balak and give him this message

verses.original: וַיָּ֣שָׁב אֵלָ֔יו וְהִנֵּ֥ה נִצָּ֖ב עַל־ עֹלָת֑וֹ ה֖וּא וְכָל־ שָׂרֵ֥י מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šāḇ ’ê·lāw wə·hin·nêh niṣ·ṣāḇ ‘al- ‘ō·lā·ṯōw hū wə·ḵāl śā·rê mō·w·’āḇ
verses.literal: So he returned to Balak who was standing there beside his burnt offering with all the princes of Moab

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֥א מְשָׁל֖וֹ וַיֹּאמַ֑ר מִן־ אֲ֠רָם יַנְחֵ֨נִי בָלָ֤ק מֶֽלֶךְ־ מוֹאָב֙ מֵֽהַרְרֵי־ קֶ֔דֶם לְכָה֙ אָֽרָה־ לִּ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב וּלְכָ֖ה זֹעֲמָ֥ה יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·śā mə·šā·lōw way·yō·mar min- ’ă·rām yan·ḥê·nî ḇā·lāq me·leḵ- mō·w·’āḇ mê·har·rê- qe·ḏem lə·ḵāh ’ā·rāh- lî ya·‘ă·qōḇ ū·lə·ḵāh zō·‘ă·māh yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And Balaam lifted up an oracle saying Balak brought me from Aram the king of Moab from the mountains of the east Come,’ he said put a curse on Jacob for me come and denounce Israel

verses.original: מָ֣ה אֶקֹּ֔ב לֹ֥א קַבֹּ֖ה אֵ֑ל וּמָ֣ה אֶזְעֹ֔ם לֹ֥א זָעַ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: māh ’eq·qōḇ lō qab·bōh ’êl ū·māh ’ez·‘ōm lō zā·‘am Yah·weh
verses.literal: How can I curse those whom God has not cursed How can I denounce those whom the LORD has not denounced

verses.original: כִּֽי־ מֵרֹ֤אשׁ צֻרִים֙ אֶרְאֶ֔נּוּ וּמִגְּבָע֖וֹת אֲשׁוּרֶ֑נּוּ הֶן־ עָם֙ לְבָדָ֣ד יִשְׁכֹּ֔ן וּבַגּוֹיִ֖ם לֹ֥א יִתְחַשָּֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: kî- mê·rōš ṣu·rîm ’er·’en·nū ū·mig·gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ ’ă·šū·ren·nū hen- ‘ām lə·ḇā·ḏāḏ yiš·kōn ū·ḇag·gō·w·yim lō yiṯ·ḥaš·šāḇ
verses.literal: For I see them from atop the rocky cliffs and I watch them from the hills Behold a people dwelling apart not reckoning themselves among the nations

verses.original: מִ֤י מָנָה֙ עֲפַ֣ר יַעֲקֹ֔ב וּמִסְפָּ֖ר אֶת־ רֹ֣בַע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל תָּמֹ֤ת נַפְשִׁי֙ מ֣וֹת יְשָׁרִ֔ים וּתְהִ֥י אַחֲרִיתִ֖י כָּמֹֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: mî mā·nāh ‘ă·p̄ar ya·‘ă·qōḇ ū·mis·pār ’eṯ- rō·ḇa‘ yiś·rā·’êl tā·mōṯ nap̄·šî mō·wṯ yə·šā·rîm ū·ṯə·hî ’a·ḥă·rî·ṯî kā·mō·hū
verses.literal: Who can count the dust of Jacob or number even a fourth of Israel Let me die the death of the righteous let my end be like theirs

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר בָּלָק֙ אֶל־ בִּלְעָ֔ם מֶ֥ה עָשִׂ֖יתָ לִ֑י לָקֹ֤ב אֹיְבַי֙ לְקַחְתִּ֔יךָ וְהִנֵּ֖ה בֵּרַ֥כְתָּ בָרֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer bā·lāq ’el- bil·‘ām meh ‘ā·śî·ṯā lî lā·qōḇ ’ō·yə·ḇay lə·qaḥ·tî·ḵā wə·hin·nêh bê·raḵ·tā ḇā·rêḵ
verses.literal: Then Balak said to Balaam What have you done to me I brought you here to curse my enemies and behold you have only blessed them . . .

verses.original: וַיַּ֖עַן וַיֹּאמַ֑ר הֲלֹ֗א אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָשִׂ֤ים יְהוָה֙ בְּפִ֔י אֹת֥וֹ אֶשְׁמֹ֖ר לְדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an way·yō·mar hă·lō ’êṯ ’ă·šer yā·śîm Yah·weh bə·p̄î ’ō·ṯōw ’eš·mōr lə·ḏab·bêr
verses.literal: But Balaam replied . . . Should I not speak exactly what the LORD puts in my mouth

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו בָּלָ֗ק לְךָ נָּ֨א אִתִּ֜י אֶל־ מָק֤וֹם אַחֵר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּרְאֶ֣נּוּ מִשָּׁ֔ם אֶ֚פֶס קָצֵ֣הוּ תִרְאֶ֔ה וְכֻלּ֖וֹ לֹ֣א תִרְאֶ֑ה וְקָבְנוֹ־ לִ֖י מִשָּֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw bā·lāq lə·ḵå̄ ’it·tî ’el- mā·qō·wm ’a·ḥêr ’ă·šer tir·’en·nū miš·šām ’e·p̄es qā·ṣê·hū ṯir·’eh wə·ḵul·lōw lō ṯir·’eh wə·qā·ḇə·nōw- lî miš·šām
verses.literal: Then Balak said to him Please come . . . with me to another place where you can see them You will only see the outskirts of their camp not all of them And from there curse them for me

verses.original: וַיִּקָּחֵ֙הוּ֙ שְׂדֵ֣ה צֹפִ֔ים אֶל־ רֹ֖אשׁ הַפִּסְגָּ֑ה וַיִּ֙בֶן֙ שִׁבְעָ֣ה מִזְבְּחֹ֔ת וַיַּ֛עַל פָּ֥ר וָאַ֖יִל בַּמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qā·ḥê·hū śə·ḏêh ṣō·p̄îm ’el- rōš hap·pis·gāh way·yi·ḇen šiḇ·‘āh miz·bə·ḥōṯ way·ya·‘al pār wā·’a·yil bam·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: So Balak took him to the field of Zophim to the top of Pisgah where he built seven altars and offered a bull and a ram on each altar

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ בָּלָ֔ק הִתְיַצֵּ֥ב כֹּ֖ה עַל־ עֹלָתֶ֑ךָ וְאָנֹכִ֖י אִקָּ֥רֶה כֹּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’el- bā·lāq hiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ kōh ‘al- ‘ō·lā·ṯe·ḵā wə·’ā·nō·ḵî ’iq·qā·reh kōh
verses.literal: Balaam said to Balak Stay here beside your burnt offering while I meet the LORD over there

verses.original: וַיִּקָּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ בִּלְעָ֔ם וַיָּ֥שֶׂם דָּבָ֖ר בְּפִ֑יו וַיֹּ֛אמֶר שׁ֥וּב אֶל־ בָּלָ֖ק וְכֹ֥ה תְדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qār Yah·weh ’el- bil·‘ām way·yā·śem dā·ḇār bə·p̄îw way·yō·mer šūḇ ’el- bā·lāq wə·ḵōh ṯə·ḏab·bêr
verses.literal: And the LORD met with Balaam and put a message in his mouth saying Return to Balak and speak what I tell you

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א אֵלָ֗יו וְהִנּ֤וֹ נִצָּב֙ עַל־ עֹ֣לָת֔וֹ וְשָׂרֵ֥י מוֹאָ֖ב אִתּ֑וֹ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ בָּלָ֔ק מַה־ דִּבֶּ֖ר יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ’ê·lāw wə·hin·nōw niṣ·ṣāḇ ‘al- ‘ō·lā·ṯōw wə·śā·rê mō·w·’āḇ ’it·tōw way·yō·mer lōw bā·lāq mah- dib·ber Yah·weh
verses.literal: So he returned to Balak who was standing there by his burnt offering with the princes of Moab What did the LORD say Balak asked

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֥א מְשָׁל֖וֹ וַיֹּאמַ֑ר ק֤וּם בָּלָק֙ וּֽשֲׁמָ֔ע הַאֲזִ֥ינָה עָדַ֖י בְּנ֥וֹ צִפֹּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·śā mə·šā·lōw way·yō·mar qūm bā·lāq ū·šă·mā‘ ha·’ă·zî·nāh ‘ā·ḏay bə·nōw ṣip·pōr
verses.literal: Then Balaam lifted up an oracle saying Arise O Balak and listen give ear to me O son of Zippor

verses.original: לֹ֣א אִ֥ישׁ אֵל֙ וִֽיכַזֵּ֔ב וּבֶן־ אָדָ֖ם וְיִתְנֶחָ֑ם הַה֤וּא אָמַר֙ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲשֶׂ֔ה וְדִבֶּ֖ר וְלֹ֥א יְקִימֶֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: lō ’îš ’êl wî·ḵaz·zêḇ ū·ḇen- ’ā·ḏām wə·yiṯ·ne·ḥām ha·hū ’ā·mar wə·lō ya·‘ă·śeh wə·ḏib·ber wə·lō yə·qî·men·nāh
verses.literal: God is not a man that He should lie or a son of man that He should change His mind Does He speak and not act Does He promise and not fulfill

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה בָרֵ֖ךְ לָקָ֑חְתִּי וּבֵרֵ֖ךְ וְלֹ֥א אֲשִׁיבֶֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ḇā·rêḵ lā·qā·ḥə·tî ū·ḇê·rêḵ wə·lō ’ă·šî·ḇen·nāh
verses.literal: I have indeed received a command to bless He has blessed and I cannot change it

verses.original: לֹֽא־ הִבִּ֥יט אָ֙וֶן֙ בְּיַעֲקֹ֔ב וְלֹא־ רָאָ֥ה עָמָ֖ל בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהָיו֙ עִמּ֔וֹ וּתְרוּעַ֥ת מֶ֖לֶךְ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lō- hib·bîṭ ’ā·wen bə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·lō- rā·’āh ‘ā·māl bə·yiś·rā·’êl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāw ‘im·mōw ū·ṯə·rū·‘aṯ me·leḵ bōw
verses.literal: He considers no disaster for Jacob He sees no trouble for Israel The LORD their God is with them and the shout of the King is among them

verses.original: אֵ֖ל מוֹצִיאָ֣ם מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם כְּתוֹעֲפֹ֥ת רְאֵ֖ם לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl mō·w·ṣî·’ām mim·miṣ·rā·yim kə·ṯō·w·‘ă·p̄ōṯ rə·’êm lōw
verses.literal: God brought them out of Egypt with strength like a wild ox

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹא־ נַ֙חַשׁ֙ בְּיַעֲקֹ֔ב וְלֹא־ קֶ֖סֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כָּעֵ֗ת יֵאָמֵ֤ר לְיַעֲקֹב֙ וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מַה־ פָּ֖עַל אֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō- na·ḥaš bə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·lō- qe·sem bə·yiś·rā·’êl kā·‘êṯ yê·’ā·mêr lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ ū·lə·yiś·rā·’êl mah- pā·‘al ’êl
verses.literal: For there is no spell against Jacob and no divination against Israel It will now be said of Jacob and Israel What great things God has done

verses.original: הֶן־ עָם֙ כְּלָבִ֣יא יָק֔וּם וְכַאֲרִ֖י יִתְנַשָּׂ֑א לֹ֤א יִשְׁכַּב֙ עַד־ יֹ֣אכַל טֶ֔רֶף וְדַם־ חֲלָלִ֖ים יִשְׁתֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hen- ‘ām kə·lā·ḇî yā·qūm wə·ḵa·’ă·rî yiṯ·naś·śā lō yiš·kaḇ ‘aḏ- yō·ḵal ṭe·rep̄ wə·ḏam- ḥă·lā·lîm yiš·teh
verses.literal: Behold the people rise like a lioness they rouse themselves like a lion not resting until they devour their prey and drink the blood of the slain

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר בָּלָק֙ אֶל־ בִּלְעָ֔ם גַּם־ קֹ֖ב לֹ֣א תִקֳּבֶ֑נּוּ גַּם־ בָּרֵ֖ךְ לֹ֥א תְבָרֲכֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer bā·lāq ’el- bil·‘ām gam- qōḇ lō ṯiq·qo·ḇen·nū gam- bā·rêḵ lō ṯə·ḇā·ră·ḵen·nū
verses.literal: Now Balak said to Balaam Then neither curse them at all . . . nor bless them at all

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַן בִּלְעָ֔ם וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֶל־ בָּלָ֑ק הֲלֹ֗א דִּבַּ֤רְתִּי אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֹת֥וֹ אֶֽעֱשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an bil·‘ām way·yō·mer ’el- bā·lāq hă·lō dib·bar·tî ’ê·le·ḵā lê·mōr kōl ’ă·šer- yə·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’ō·ṯōw ’e·‘ĕ·śeh
verses.literal: But Balaam . . . . . . replied Did I not tell you that . . . . . . whatever the LORD says I must do

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר בָּלָק֙ אֶל־ בִּלְעָ֔ם לְכָה־ נָּא֙ אֶקָּ֣חֲךָ֔ אֶל־ מָק֖וֹם אַחֵ֑ר אוּלַ֤י יִישַׁר֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וְקַבֹּ֥תוֹ לִ֖י מִשָּֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer bā·lāq ’el- bil·‘ām lə·ḵāh- nā ’eq·qā·ḥă·ḵā ’el- mā·qō·wm ’a·ḥêr ’ū·lay yî·šar bə·‘ê·nê hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·qab·bō·ṯōw lî miš·šām
verses.literal: Please come said Balak - I will take you to another place Perhaps it will please . . . God that you curse them for me from there

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֥ח בָּלָ֖ק אֶת־ בִּלְעָ֑ם רֹ֣אשׁ הַפְּע֔וֹר הַנִּשְׁקָ֖ף עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַיְשִׁימֹֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ bā·lāq ’eṯ- bil·‘ām rōš hap·pə·‘ō·wr han·niš·qāp̄ ‘al- pə·nê hay·šî·mōn
verses.literal: And Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor which overlooks . . . . . . the wasteland

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר בִּלְעָם֙ אֶל־ בָּלָ֔ק בְּנֵה־ לִ֥י בָזֶ֖ה שִׁבְעָ֣ה מִזְבְּחֹ֑ת וְהָכֵ֥ן לִי֙ בָּזֶ֔ה שִׁבְעָ֥ה פָרִ֖ים וְשִׁבְעָ֥ה אֵילִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer bil·‘ām ’el- bā·lāq bə·nêh- lî ḇā·zeh šiḇ·‘āh miz·bə·ḥōṯ wə·hā·ḵên lî bā·zeh šiḇ·‘āh p̄ā·rîm wə·šiḇ·‘āh ’ê·lîm
verses.literal: Then Balaam . . . said Build for me seven altars here and prepare for me . . . seven bulls and seven rams

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ בָּלָ֔ק כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר אָמַ֣ר בִּלְעָ֑ם וַיַּ֛עַל פָּ֥ר וָאַ֖יִל בַּמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś bā·lāq ka·’ă·šer ’ā·mar bil·‘ām way·ya·‘al pār wā·’a·yil bam·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: So Balak did as Balaam had instructed and he offered a bull and a ram on each altar
